Freelancer Công việc Revit

Licensed Australian PE/Architect Needed

Licensed Australian PE/Architect Needed

$15-25 USD/ giờ

Đang mở

Đã đăng vào khoảng 1 giờ trước

•

Kết thúc sau 6 ngày

$15-25 USD/ giờ

I manage a steady flow of residential and light-commercial builds that roll out in several Australian jurisdictions, so I’m looking for an ongoing partner who already holds an Australian registration—whether as a professional engineer (structural / civil) or as a registered architect—to keep our documentation compliant and sign-off ready for lodgement. Most of the workload revolves around structural or civil engineering packages: reviewing calculation sets, checking drawings for NCC and state-specific code alignment, and issuing final certification that councils and private certifiers will accept. Because the sites span multiple states and territories, familiarity with mutual recognition of registration and the subtle variations in local planning regulations will be important. Typical hand-offs include full drawing sets (DWG / PDF) and calculation reports produced in Revit, AutoCAD, and RAM or SpaceGass. I’ll share my mark-ups first, then count on you to flag non-conformances, suggest fixes, and finally stamp and return the approved documents. Deliverables for each assignment • Red-lined review set (PDF) • Signed compliance certificate or Form 15/16 (as relevant) • Brief cover note outlining any assumptions or conditions Turnaround is generally one week, though I can plan around your schedule if you let me know early. Professional indemnity details and a copy of your current registration will be required before the first project proceeds. If you’re licensed, comfortable working remotely, and interested in a long-term collaboration, I’d like to hear about your recent comparable sign-offs and availability. Freelancers must confirm they are licensed under QBCC and eligible to produce residential building designs in Queensland, Australia.
